items.title: Portal 2 gamescom 2010 Demonstration - Full HD (1080p)
items.observation: Directly viewed thumbnail shows a physical monitor, surrounding bezel and perspective distortion. Uploader credits a friend for filming the event.1080p25 stream exists, but that is not verification of a native FHD game capture or compatible shot/rights.
items.decision: Do not adopt off-screen event recording as native gameplay replacement; existing rules also exclude stage demonstration footage. No video downloaded, decoded or selected.

scope: Archive page/metadata/thumbnail evidence; no new gameplay source adopted. Do not repeat unchanged rejected mirrors, off-screen recordings or inaccessible archive attempts.
